diagnostics.message: :resource.helm_release.karpenter: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references

The explicit dependency from :resource.helm_release.karpenter to :module.eks is redundant because the release's values already reference module.eks.cluster_name and module.eks.cluster_endpoint, creating an implicit dependency.

The add-ons are explicitly ordered after the self-managed node group, but the EKS cluster itself should be established before creating add-ons. These resources only use the cluster name variable, so no dependency on :module.eks is expressed.
